dfm.message: NOT FIT-VERIFIED: board Z, screw mounts, USB access, lid retention, hinge life/cable bend, battery
NOT ELECTRICALLY VERIFIED: two SP3485 RS485 A/B ports, termination, half-duplex communication and common-ground/power reference
NOT PHYSICALLY VERIFIED: second Waveshare LCD module mounting Z/USB and touchscreen closure clearance
NOT FUNCTIONALLY VERIFIED: LVGL virtual keyboard, Ctrl/Esc/Alt/Tab, framed RS485 key events, SSH pinned host key and reconnect

bom.notes: One per clamshell half. SP3485 RS485 transceiver onboard; full PCB Z/ports not yet measured

bom.item: RS485 differential pair + verified common reference
bom.spec: 2-wire A/B HY2.0 2P plus safe shared power ground
bom.notes: Two on-board SP3485; verify A/B polarity, half-duplex timing, 120-ohm termination and ground. No loose 5V GPIO wiring

bom.spec: RS485 + potential 5V/GND power cable; test flex radius
bom.notes: Mechanical cable passage is a concept, NOT fatigue/lid-cycle proven
Test retention and tolerance after printing; no plastic hinge pin
Second LCD rather than CardKB; module mount/USB access absent
Upper LCD module mount/USB access absent

bom.spec: 5V 2A or higher verified, two USB-C power leads
bom.notes: Power both boards through their designated USB inputs for first bench only; no shared battery wiring approved

bom.spec: 3.7V single cell PER board, PH2.0 polarity to verify
bom.notes: Not included; do not parallel two on-board charger outputs

notes: Two separate vendor RGB display/ESP32/touch assemblies with onboard SP3485 RS485 keyboard event link. Ordinary 2mm pin hinge, NO flexible OLED, NO LCD FPC across hinge; separate 5V USB-C supplies first. Shell/dimensions illustrative without physical Z/ports. No device built, no host key/SSH tested.
